scientific_intent.scientific_task: Search a Gaussian bandwidth/precision for each distance row to match a target entropy.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Normalize exp(-distance*beta), estimate entropy log(sumP)+beta*weightedDistance, bisect/double/halve beta toward log8.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 4096 independent rows of32 neighbor distances; no vocabulary or token axis.
invariants: Rows approximately sum to one with source epsilon normalization.
Target entropy is conditional on convergence, not guaranteed by epoch cap alone.
accuracy_requirements: All131072 finite Float32 affinities compared at absolute1e-3; convergence threshold1e-8 and100maximumepochs preserved.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Native fast exp/log/divide versus Julia generic math can affect bisection stopping and work counts, not only final rounding.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: 4096x32,targetperplexity8,maxepochs100,tol1e-8,ten repeats; actual per-row executed iterations unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source explicitly says find best Gaussian bandwidth per row. This is an affinity/entropy-search primitive, not language-model perplexity.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No explicit t-SNE application is named in the native source; downstream embedding use remains an inference, not a provenance claim.
